content_units: Movie Night Fit for Four

A tight set of   8 stream-from-your-library picks   that match your filters: witty sci-fi or mystery,   minimal gore  ,   no sexual assault themes  ,   under 130 minutes  ,   1995–2020  , with   at least 2 non-English titles   included.
Eight Strong Picks
Film   Year   Language   Genre lane   Runtime   Why it works   Content caution

Coherence     2013   English   Sci-fi mystery   89 min   A smart, fast-moving dinner-party mind-bender that gives a group plenty to debate without relying on spectacle.   Tense paranoia, arguments, some mild violence and unsettling identity confusion.

The Prestige     2006   English   Mystery thriller   130 min   A clever puzzle-box rivalry with constant reveals, ideal if your group likes paying attention and comparing theories.   Dark obsession, peril, a few disturbing moments, but little onscreen gore.

Moon     2009   English   Sci-fi mystery   97 min   Thoughtful, witty in a dry way, and emotionally engaging while staying compact and low on graphic content.   Isolation, psychological distress, brief injury imagery.

Source Code     2011   English   Sci-fi mystery   93 min   A brisk, crowd-pleasing time-loop thriller that stays clever and accessible for a shared movie night.   Repeated train explosion scenario, suspense, brief combat and aftermath imagery.

Attack the Block     2011   English   Sci-fi comedy   88 min   Funny, energetic, and very easy to watch with a group if you want witty banter plus creature chaos.   Creature attacks, moderate action violence, some strong language, minimal gore.

The Invisible Guest (Contratiempo)     2016   Spanish   Mystery thriller   106 min   A twisty, high-engagement whodunit that rewards close attention and usually sparks post-movie argument in the best way.   Murder themes, emotional intensity, some non-graphic violence.

Timecrimes (Los cronocrimenes)     2007   Spanish   Sci-fi mystery   92 min   Ingenious and darkly funny, this is one of the sharpest low-budget time-travel puzzles ever made.   Sustained tension, stalking threat, brief violence, some unsettling scenes.

The Last Circus (Balada triste de trompeta)     2010   Spanish   Dark mystery/surreal thriller   107 min   If your group can handle something stranger and more chaotic, it offers inventive style and bizarre mystery energy.   More intense than the others: stylized violence, disturbing imagery, emotional cruelty.
Best Match Order for This Specific Brief
Option 1:   Coherence     Best overall fit for witty, low-gore, discussion-heavy sci-fi mystery     Shortest high-payoff pick
Option 2:   The Invisible Guest     Best pure mystery choice for adults who enjoy twists and theory-swapping     Non-English standout
Option 3:   Source Code     Safest crowd-pleaser if tastes are mixed and you want something brisk     Very accessible pacing
Option 4:   Moon     Best if you want thoughtful sci-fi with low chaos and strong conversation afterward     Quiet but gripping
Quick Pick by Vibe
-   Most talkative after the credits:   Coherence
-   Best twist machine:   The Invisible Guest
-   Most fun/energetic:   Attack the Block
-   Most cerebral:   Moon
-   Most prestige-style puzzle:   The Prestige
-   Strangest choice:   Timecrimes
Quick Actions
Randomize 1–8
